headline: Oil Supply Fears Grow
what: Brent crude rose above $104 as uncertainty over Middle East production and shipping persisted.
context: The benchmark has moved between roughly $96 and $110 during the past month.
why_it_matters: Why it matters: supply disruptions can raise fuel, freight, airfare, and manufacturing costs across countries.

headline: Fed Signals Another Increase
what: Minutes from the September meeting showed most Federal Reserve officials expected another rate increase could be needed this year.
context: Officials continued to weigh persistent inflation against labor-market and financial conditions.
why_it_matters: Why it matters: a higher policy path can lift borrowing costs for households, companies, and governments.

headline: Global Indexes Retreat
what: South Korea's KOSPI fell 2.6%, Japan's Nikkei lost 1.4%, and Germany's DAX traded about 1% lower.
why_it_matters: Why it matters: the broad pullback shows that strain from energy costs and higher yields extends beyond U.S. markets.

headline: PepsiCo Raises Prices
what: PepsiCo reported 5.6% net revenue growth but said it would raise selected prices and cut costs after weaker North American performance.
why_it_matters: Why it matters: packaged-food pricing offers a window into household demand, company margins, and input costs.
